chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Shādhān ibn al-Khalīl al-Naysābūrī, from Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
I asked him about a woman who begins menstruating after the sun has passed the meridian, and she has not performed the ẓuhr prayer: is she required to make up that prayer? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman about whom the legal ruling is being asked
key_terms.تَزُولُ: it declines from the middle; here, the sun passes the meridian and prayer time begins
key_terms.تَطْمَثُ: she menstruates; her menstrual bleeding begins
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: making up an obligatory act after its time
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative answer establishing the ruling

ai.seo_question: If a woman begins menstruating after the time of ẓuhr starts, must she make up the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman whose menstruation begins after the time of ẓuhr prayer has entered. It states that if the prayer time had already begun and she had not performed the prayer before menstruation started, then she must make up that prayer.
